scope: Every pending borrowed-handle route in the pinned script API accounting artifact, exactly once
coverageClaim: Classification and implementation-order planning only. A classified route is not runtime evidence and does not claim native, HTML5, or Static Hermes conformance.
allocationClaim: After fixed-capacity bridge registries and Lua stack/registry storage are prewarmed, the generated lookup and dispatch glue can avoid C++ heap allocation on handle-consuming calls. This does not claim that Lua, Defold, Box2D, Bullet, GUI, graphics, resource, or user callbacks are allocation-free; handle capture, object creation, table growth, and engine operations may allocate.

implementationOrder.reason: Consumes existing handles without creating bridge ownership or retiring engine identity.
Introduces concrete return-kind checks, Lua rooting, ownership policy, and finalizer behavior.
Destroys a body-owned child selected by integer index while preserving the validated parent body and its host handle.
Invalidates the wrapped engine identity after success but preserves the rooted host userdata so is_valid can observe false and native validators retain Defold semantics.
Belongs in the TypeScript component/property compiler and must not be represented as a runtime handle.

handleKinds.validity: Validate stored game-object collection/id/generation when present, then b2Body_IsValid on every terminal call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Owning collision object, game object, or Box2D world destruction; explicit body-owned child destruction does not transfer ownership to the wrapper.

handleKinds.validity: Validate b2Chain_IsValid on every terminal call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Explicit chain destruction, owning body/world destruction, or Box2D generation mismatch.

handleKinds.validity: Validate b2Joint_IsValid on every terminal call and retain source tracking for whether destroy is permitted.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Explicit destroy, connected body/world destruction, or Box2D generation mismatch.

handleKinds.validity: Validate b2Shape_IsValid on every terminal call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Explicit fixture/shape destruction, owning body/world destruction, or Box2D generation mismatch.

handleKinds.validity: Validate b2World_IsValid on every terminal call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Owning physics component-world destruction or Box2D generation mismatch.

handleKinds.validity: Preserve the exact LuaHBuffer wrapper and validate resource path/version plus dmBuffer::IsBufferValid.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Lua-owned GC, resource replacement/release, explicit native destruction, or buffer generation invalidation.

handleKinds.validity: Preserve the stream userdata registry reference to its parent and validate dmBuffer::IsBufferValid before access.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Parent buffer invalidation; the source view retains a raw stream pointer and therefore must not be flattened.

handleKinds.validity: Resolve the source monotonic constraint id on every call and preserve world-lock checks.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Explicit destroy, connected body destruction, world destruction, or script Bullet finalization.

handleKinds.validity: Resolve the source monotonic collision-object id, validate collection/instance generation, and for btRigidBody require a successful checked upcast.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Collision-object or game-object destruction invokes source invalidation; owning world teardown also invalidates.

handleKinds.validity: Resolve owner by source monotonic id and bounds-check the stored shape index on every call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Owner invalidation or removal of the indexed shape slot.

handleKinds.validity: Resolve the source monotonic world id on every call.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Physics component-world destruction invokes source invalidation.

handleKinds.validity: Validate against the active graphics context with IsAssetHandleValid and require ASSET_TYPE_RENDER_TARGET.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Explicit render-target deletion, resource replacement, or graphics-context teardown.

handleKinds.validity: Validate against the active graphics context and expected texture asset type before use.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Owning resource/render-target deletion or graphics-context teardown.

handleKinds.validity: Require the active GUI scene to equal the proxy scene, then validate the HNode version/index.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Deferred GUI delete flush, parent subtree deletion, node-slot version change, or scene destruction.

handleKinds.validity: Require the registered constant-buffer userdata type in the active render script.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Lua userdata finalization deletes the named constant buffer; bridge release must preserve that finalizer boundary.

handleKinds.validity: Accept only inside the go.property declaration compiler and resolve to a compiled resource path/hash.
handleKinds.invalidationBoundary: Compile-time component schema regeneration; never place this token in the runtime handle registry.
